Keep customers in sync with a HubSpot portal. A business connects once through HubSpot's install screen; after that every change is pushed within a minute while autosync is on, and a full sync runs every 15 minutes. Each run and every record it touched is on the sync log.

## Endpoints

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/integrations/hubspot`](/help/developers/api-reference/hubspot/get-the-business-s-hubspot-connection-and-sync-h) | Get the business's HubSpot connection and sync health |
| `PATCH` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/integrations/hubspot`](/help/developers/api-reference/hubspot/change-sync-preferences) | Change sync preferences |
| `DELETE` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/integrations/hubspot`](/help/developers/api-reference/hubspot/disconnect-hubspot) | Disconnect HubSpot |
| `GET` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/integrations/hubspot/conflicts`](/help/developers/api-reference/hubspot/list-open-sync-conflicts) | List open sync conflicts, oldest first |
| `POST` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/integrations/hubspot/conflicts/{id}/resolve`](/help/developers/api-reference/hubspot/resolve-a-sync-conflict) | Resolve a sync conflict |
| `POST` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/integrations/hubspot/connect`](/help/developers/api-reference/hubspot/finish-a-hubspot-install-with-the-authorization) | Finish a HubSpot install with the authorization code |
| `GET` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/integrations/hubspot/local_fields`](/help/developers/api-reference/hubspot/list-the-fields-a-mapping-may-name-on-our-side) | List the fields a mapping may name on our side |
| `GET` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/integrations/hubspot/objects`](/help/developers/api-reference/hubspot/list-the-connected-portal-s-custom-objects) | List the connected portal's custom objects |
| `GET` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/integrations/hubspot/pipelines`](/help/developers/api-reference/hubspot/list-the-connected-portal-s-deal-pipelines-and-s) | List the connected portal's deal pipelines and stages |
| `GET` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/integrations/hubspot/properties/{object}`](/help/developers/api-reference/hubspot/list-the-connected-portal-s-properties-for-an-ob) | List the connected portal's properties for an object |
| `POST` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/integrations/hubspot/start`](/help/developers/api-reference/hubspot/start-the-first-sync) | Start the first sync |
| `POST` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/integrations/hubspot/sync`](/help/developers/api-reference/hubspot/sync-now) | Sync now |
| `GET` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/integrations/hubspot/sync_runs`](/help/developers/api-reference/hubspot/list-sync-runs) | List sync runs, newest first |
| `GET` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/integrations/hubspot/sync_runs/{run}`](/help/developers/api-reference/hubspot/get-a-sync-run-with-its-log) | Get a sync run with its log |
| `POST` | [`/v1/hubspot/app/actions/create-subscription`](/help/developers/api-reference/hubspot/workflow-action) | Workflow action: create a subscription from a deal |
| `POST` | [`/v1/hubspot/app/actions/edit-subscription`](/help/developers/api-reference/hubspot/workflow-action-2) | Workflow action: edit the deal's subscription |
| `POST` | [`/v1/hubspot/app/actions/price-options`](/help/developers/api-reference/hubspot/price-options-for-the-workflow-actions-plan-fiel) | Price options for the workflow actions' plan field |
| `POST` | [`/v1/hubspot/app/card`](/help/developers/api-reference/hubspot/billing-card-data-for-a-hubspot-record) | Billing card data for a HubSpot record |
